text.p: Wanadoo, the online service offered by France Telecom, has 21,000 subscribers and is aiming for 100,000 clients by the end of 1997, France Telecom multimedia division managing director Gerard Eymery said.
He told a news conference Wanadoo would start experimenting in March with electronic payment.
This will take three forms. First, a system allowing payment of services via the Wanadoo monthly bill, and second, a Cybercash technology developed by Banque Sofinco, part of Cie de Suez.
Future solutions to be developed by the e-Comm consortium, founded in July by BNP, Societe Generale, France Telecom, Gemplus and Visa International, will first be tested on Wanadoo.
Credit Lyonnais has recently joined the e-Comm consortium which is looking into a chip-card solution to make electronic payment on the internet.
